title: BEST NEW IRON FARM! Minecraft Tutorial 1.21 - 0 SECOND!
description: In this Tutorial, I Will Show you how to make the next generation of iron farms. This farm works based on using a new method, Force Tech, that will force all 4 villages to work at once, preventing loop issues that happen if a golem is already spawned before. This makes this farm spawn 4 golems at once, making it a high-performance iron farm in Minecraft!
